@musicthebee doctrine's CLI comes with an `orm:validate-schema` command. You can also manually use the [`SchemaValidator`](https://github.com/doctrine/doctrine2/blob/31a0c02b066764ec7b55eedc5f3cab78235a4e4b/lib/Doctrine/ORM/Tools/SchemaValidator.php), if you have a custom setup.

`[Mapping]  OK - The mapping files are correct.
[Database] FAIL - The database schema is not in sync with the current mapping file.`

Redoing with a simple test case and will post back result

I used the `orm:schema:update` --force to update schema and that goes through fine

After that when I run `orm:validate-schema` I still get 
`[Mapping] OK - The mapping files are correct. [Database] FAIL - The database schema is not in sync with the current mapping file.`

Is there anyway to check what exactly the issue with the schema is? I tried --verbose but that doesnt give any more information

Thanks
